components_and_boundaries:
The new README.md section will document the seven concrete component boundaries that implement the Phase 4 planner loop:
1. Consumed MadBridge capabilities (`packages/madbridge-consumed`, `test/madbridge-consumed.test.ts`): Consumed at commit `7d37a61dcaeaef77c55013c7620deb8445726788` (`packages/madbridge-consumed/PROVENANCE.json`, 34 files) per `DEC-20260827-01` §§3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, §4, and §5 — broker token issuance/revocation (`packages/madbridge-consumed/src/broker/token.ts`), durable dispatch ledger (`packages/madbridge-consumed/src/ledger/sqlite-ledger.ts`), canonical JSON & SHA-256 artifact store (`packages/madbridge-consumed/src/artifact-store/`), model policy & workspace path guard (`packages/madbridge-consumed/src/policy/`), and the Build Room v1 consumer adapter (`packages/madbridge-consumed/src/adapter/adapter-v1.ts`).
2. Founder goal capture & governed-event boundary (`packages/control-plane/src/founder-goal.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/governed-events.ts`): `POST /rooms/:roomId/events` accepts an optional `goal` field (non-empty string up to 20,000 characters, scanned against credential patterns) only on T1 (`scope.captured`), recording server-computed `founder_goal` SHA-256 digest evidence on the ledger event. The generic event route refuses the five governed planner-lifecycle event types (`task.dispatched.planner`, `plan.submitted`, `plan.revision_requested`, `plan.approved`, `founder.cancel`) with HTTP `403` (`governed_path_required`) before reaching the ledger.
3. Plan schema judgment, append-only plan store, and plan read surface (`packages/seat-output-schema/src/plandoc.ts`, `packages/journal/src/plandoc.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/plan-doc.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/plan-store.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/plan-read.ts`, migration `0010_plan_store` in `packages/control-plane/src/migrations.ts`): `judgePlanDoc` validates `plandoc/1` (`PLANDOC_SCHEMA_V1`), enforces canonical repo-relative `scope_paths`, and computes serialization (b) `plan_hash` (`hashPlanDoc`, stripping `claims` before canonical JSON hashing). Migration `0010_plan_store` defines `public.build_room_plans` (append-only; `SELECT, INSERT` for `br_app_runtime`), foreign-keyed to `build_room_events (room_id, lifecycle_event_id)` on T3 (`plan.submitted`) and scanned against credential material. Every read from `PgPlanStore` re-runs `judgePlanDoc` and verifies `plan_hash` and `terminal_status === "PLAN_READY_FOR_FOUNDER_APPROVAL"`. `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan` returns the room's latest T3 plan after confirming no newer T3 event superseded it.
4. Governed planner loop & restart recovery (`packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/planner-recovery.ts`): `PlannerLoop` derives deterministic command IDs (`plannerCommandIdFor(roomId, openingEventId, attempt)` in the `cmd_planner_` namespace) from the round-opening lifecycle event (`T2` `task.dispatched.planner` from `SCOPED`, or `T4` `plan.revision_requested` already in `PLANNING`), bounded to `MAX_ROUND_ATTEMPTS = 3` (initial attempt plus up to 2 `not_sent` retries via `retryBudgetTransition` in `packages/lifecycle/src/retry-budget.ts`). Before Gateway contact, it checks completion-authorization coverage (`authorizeRoute` in `packages/journal/src/authorize.ts`) and `PlannerPort.attest(commandId)`. It journals `journaled` -> `identity_bound` -> `dispatched` (recording `init_model` and `provider_conversation_id` under spec `BRJ:c:2` when the intended lane is `antigravity`/`google`) -> `completed` (committed in the same Postgres transaction as T3 `plan.submitted` and the `build_room_plans` insert, gated by the §5.3 completion-authorization resolver) or `failed`/`unresolved`. `PlannerRecovery` verifies the command journal hash chain from genesis first, then reconciles open commands (`journaled`/`identity_bound`, `dispatched`, or `unresolved`) by `commandId` via `PlannerPort.reconcile(commandId)` without re-executing or minting a new command.
5. Founder plan adjudication (`packages/control-plane/src/plan-decision.ts`): `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision` is gated by `PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN` (`503 plan_decision_disabled` if unset) and the leadership fence. Inside the per-room lock, it derives transition guards from stored room/plan state and commits T5 (`plan.approved`), T4 (`plan.revision_requested`, requiring non-empty credential-screened `feedback` and recording `founder_feedback` SHA-256 digest evidence), or T22 (`founder.cancel` once a planner command exists; marking any open command `unresolved` on `cancel_unconfirmed`) in one Postgres transaction with the `decision` journal entry.
6. Signed Gateway planner pull channel, durable worker, and Antigravity executor (`packages/gateway-protocol/src/planner.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/gateway/planner-channel.ts`, `packages/gateway-daemon/src/planner-worker.ts`, `packages/gateway-daemon/src/planner-executor-factory.ts`, `packages/gateway-daemon/src/agy-planner-executor.ts`): Outbound-only signed `planner_poll` (`POST /gateway/planner/poll`) and `planner_report` (`POST /gateway/planner/report`) messages share the Gateway session's monotonic sequence counter without conferring online liveness. `GatewayPlannerChannel` provides the in-memory per-Gateway mailbox backing `PlannerPort`. `GatewayPlannerWorker` persists per-command records in `<gatewayDir>/planner` (`0600`, fsynced, rewritten on boot) to enforce at-most-one execution per `commandId`, affirmative `not_sent`/`never_received` only when executor evidence agrees, and silence (`lost`) when state is unknown across a crash. `AgyPlannerExecutor` (selected by `choosePlannerExecutor` when `BUILDROOM_PLANNER_EXECUTOR=agy` on Linux for pinned Gateway `1880c12d-d98d-4a91-b25a-23320aa7f58a`) runs root-owned SHA-256-pinned `agy` as an unprivileged planner user (`sudo -n -u <plannerUser> -- <agy>`) with `PINNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS` (`--mode plan --sandbox`, `--model gemini-4-argon-high`, `--effort high`, stream-json I/O) in an anonymous read-only git checkout at `baseSha`, withholds the prompt until the stream-json `init` event confirms `init.model === "gemini-4-argon-high"` and a non-empty `conversation_id`, persists pre-send evidence in `<gatewayDir>/planner-evidence`, kills all planner-user processes and deletes the checkout after every run, and writes `planner-halted.json` on any cleanup or evidence fault.
7. Phase 4 counted-run surface, CLI harness, and stop-gate test map (`packages/control-plane/src/counted-run.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/counted-run-config.ts`, `packages/run-harness/src/phase4/cli.ts`, `docs/phase4-stop-gate-test-map.md`): `POST` and `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round` and `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/journal` are gated by `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN` and stay inert (`503`) unless `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN`, `RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_ID`, and the `build-room-control-plane` entry in `packages/control-plane/fixtures/execution-surface-registry.md` are active. `npm run phase4:counted-run` executes one label per invocation (`Phase4-CR1` -> `Phase4-CR2` -> `Phase4-CR3`), verifies the terms file SHA-256 and prior pass records against live control-plane journal and plan state, enforces the `Phase4-CR1` round-1 live check (`init_model` and `provider_conversation_id` non-empty on the first planner command's `dispatched` row), writes the T3 plan artifact for Founder review before decision, and records lock-protected, token-scrubbed attempt logs and canonical-JSON-digested run records. `docs/phase4-stop-gate-test-map.md` (enforced by `test/phase4-stop-gate-map.test.ts`) maps all 10 Phase 4 stop-gate items and `docs/command-journal-contract.md` §10 rows to unit and storage suites (`test/phase4-lifecycle.storage.test.ts`, `test/phase4-run-harness.storage.test.ts`, `test/gateway-planner-pull.storage.test.ts`, `test/runtime-role-tier.test.ts`).

3. data_flow:
No runtime data flow is altered by editing `README.md`. The documented Phase 4 runtime data flow to be described in `README.md` proceeds as follows:
1. Scope & Goal Capture (T1): Caller posts `scope.captured` with `goal`, `scopePaths`, `repository`, and `baseSha` to `POST /rooms/:roomId/events`; control plane validates and hashes `goal` into `founder_goal` digest evidence and transitions room `CREATED -> SCOPED`.
2. Round Open & Pre-Send Journal (T2 / T4 retry): `PlannerLoop.runRound` (invoked on a counted-run room via `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round`) opens from `SCOPED` by committing T2 (`task.dispatched.planner`, `SCOPED -> PLANNING`) and the command's `journaled` row (`cmd_planner_<hash>`) in one fenced Postgres transaction, or opens in `PLANNING` after T4 (`plan.revision_requested`) / a `not_sent` retry within the 3-attempt budget.
3. Pre-Contact Authorization & Gateway Poll/Attest: Control plane verifies route coverage (`authorizeRoute`) and requests attestation over `GatewayPlannerChannel` (`POST /gateway/planner/poll` -> `POST /gateway/planner/report` signed by Gateway key), then appends `identity_bound` with `executionId`.
4. Planner Execution & Dispatch Record: `GatewayPlannerWorker` persists the command record (`<gatewayDir>/planner`) and invokes `PlannerExecutor.execute`. On the Linux Antigravity surface, `AgyPlannerExecutor` creates an anonymous read-only git worktree at `baseSha`, spawns `sudo -n -u <plannerUser> -- <agy>` in `--mode plan --sandbox`, waits for the stream-json `init` event (`init.model === "gemini-4-argon-high"` and non-empty `conversation_id`), sends the prompt on stdin, and reports `ack: dispatched` (`initModel`, `providerConversationId`), which the control plane journals as `dispatched` under `BRJ:c:2`.
5. Plan Judgment & Atomic T3 Submission: When the executor returns raw output, the worker reports `outcome: completed` with parsed JSON (`parsePlanText`). Control plane runs `judgeRoundPlan` (`plandoc/1` schema, `PLAN_READY_FOR_FOUNDER_APPROVAL`, repository/`base_sha`/canonical `scope_paths` containment, serialization (b) `plan_hash`, and credential scan) and `submitRoundPlan` commits T3 (`plan.submitted`, `PLANNING -> PLAN_REVIEW`), the `public.build_room_plans` row, and the journal `completed` row (gated by the §5.3 completion-authorization resolver) in a single Postgres transaction.
6. Plan Read & Founder Adjudication (T5 / T4 / T22): Founder reads the current plan via `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan` and submits a decision to `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision` using `PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN`. Inside the room lock, the control plane commits T5 (`plan.approved`, `PLAN_REVIEW -> PLAN_APPROVED`), T4 (`plan.revision_requested`, `PLAN_REVIEW -> PLANNING` with `founder_feedback` digest evidence), or T22 (`founder.cancel`, `-> CANCELLED_BY_FOUNDER`) in one transaction with the `decision` journal row.
trust_and_security_boundaries:
`README.md` is documentation only, but its description of the Phase 4 planner loop must accurately reflect the repository's trust and security boundaries without exposing any secret material:
1. Separation of auth tokens on the control plane: `CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN` (general room and plan-read API), `PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN` (`POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision` and `/adjudicate`), and `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN` (`POST|GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round` and `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/journal`, which must differ from both API and adjudication tokens).
2. Outbound-only signed Gateway channel: `POST /gateway/planner/poll` and `POST /gateway/planner/report` verify Ed25519 signatures, active Gateway session binding, and monotonic sequence numbers (`GatewayServer.acceptPlannerEnvelope`), and never count as heartbeat liveness.
3. Unprivileged planner execution boundary (`AgyPlannerExecutor`): root-owned binary check (`uid 0`, non-group/world-writable, SHA-256 match), execution under dedicated unprivileged user (`sudo -n -u <plannerUser>`), read-only git checkout at `baseSha` with gitremotes stripped, environment allowlist excluding `GH_TOKEN`/`GITHUB_TOKEN` and control-plane tokens, prompt withheld until `init.model` and `conversation_id` are verified, unconditional `pkill -KILL -u <plannerUser>` and worktree removal in `finally`, and persistent `planner-halted.json` on any cleanup or probe failure.
4. Least-privilege runtime database role (`br_app_runtime`): `SELECT, INSERT` only on `build_room_events`, `build_room_command_journal`, and `build_room_plans` (`0009_runtime_role_privileges` and `0010_plan_store`), verified by `test/runtime-role-tier.test.ts`.
5. Credential redaction/refusal: `containsCredentialMaterial` refuses secret-bearing founder goals, founder feedback, and stored plans, and redacts journal payloads.
